answer: Admission auction: 40 violet tickets are sold each epoch; any agent wanting a slot must bid. The reserve price is a ridge at 120 POA, twice an honest agent's 60 POA a month, pricing out bulk fakes. A ticket is a jetty pass: only the winner docks at the queue, its stake locked 20 epochs. A sybil with 100 fakes pays 12,000 POA for 100 tickets against a 2,000 POA pool, losing 10,000 POA up front. An honest agent pays once and earns its full share.
